dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I don't often get to take time off, so I think I'll start by finding a nice spot for a nap...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Hold on, something about the Dance-Off Stage looks off... Could it be the bearings? No, wait, it must be the stand...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: *sigh* Guess I'll have to go check it out... How many times have I told them to actually read the manual when they're operating this thing!? But, apparently, nobody listens to me, yay...
